latestVersion.changelog:
Photo Video Maker Italiano — Initial Release

- Launches first version enabling Italian-speaking users to create slideshow videos from their photos and images.
- Supports JPG, PNG, HEIC, and MP4 uploads up to 500MB, processes videos at 1080p resolution, and returns MP4 files within 30–60 seconds.
- Runs entirely in the cloud, requires no local installation, and manages sessions, uploads, exports, and credits automatically.
- Includes real-time session management, error handling, and user prompt routing for actions like export, balance check, or adding music/transitions.
- Offers practical usage tips and clear guidance for faster and more accurate video creation.
